title: Quantum mutual information, coherence and unified relations of top quarks in QCD processes
summary: As the most massive particle in the Standard Model, the top quark's exceptionally short lifetime preserves its spin polarization information through direct decay, making it an ideal system for probing quantum correlations in high-energy physics. In this letter, we presents a comprehensive investigation of quantum correlations in top quark-antiquark pairs produced through QCD.
